tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search ~88k AI agent tools (MCP servers, Agent Skills, Claude Code plugins) by keywords. Returns ranked matches with type, category, GitHub stars, badges (first_party = made by the product's own maker, verified_publisher, live, free_to_try), install line and KitScout page. Use short keywords: produc

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Details for one KitScout tool by its exact name: description, badges, stars, repo, install or connect instructions, and for remote MCP servers the actual tool list the server exposes (from our live check).

tools.name: check_tools
tools.description: Before installing tools you found elsewhere (web search, a README, a blog), verify them: is it the product maker's own tool, maintained (last code change, archived?), adopted (stars), does the remote server answer right now, where does your data go — with a verdict (ok / caution / avoid) and better

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All KitScout categories (id, name, group, tool count). Useful to see what kinds of tools exist before searching.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, check_tools · Public sink: search_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, check_tools · Public sink: search_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
